About the Company: 

Ruder Finn is seeking a Senior Data Analyst (Data Analyst III) to join its award-winning Emerging Technology & Analytics team. The chosen candidate will support the agency’s new business efforts by spearheading the research activities such as but not limited to earned media analysis, social listening, influencer identification, data modeling and predictive analytics. This individual will collaborate with several account teams within the agency providing counsel as needed on the various research and analytics needs of the agency’s clients. As Data Analyst III, you will have the opportunity to work alongside the Chief Technology Officer based in New York, NY, on several innovative Consumer, Technology, and Healthcare-related client accounts. The ideal candidate would be a digital native with deep expertise in and a passion for data visualization and storytelling, statistics, web analytics, social media analytics, and the ability to connect the dots back to business objectives. 

This position will be fully remote, and the working hours will be either 6:00 pm – 3:30 am IST / 8:30 am – 6:00 pm ET  or 2:00 pm – 11:00 pm IST / 4:30 am – 1:30 pm ET . 

Ultimately, your work will help define the business strategy for projects and clients and play a significant role in the growth of the agency.

- Deliver market and audience intelligence, including social and digital landscape analysis, audience behavior analysis, sentiment analysis, keyword research, search performance, and competitor analysis including but not limited to share of voice and message pull through

Qualifications:

- Expertise in Excel, Google Sheets, Google Analytics and one or more contemporary data visualization platforms (e.g.: Tableau, Power BI, Google Data Studio, etc.) along with SQL

- Experience with data modeling and developing custom models is a plus 
- Experience with custom LLMs and working with the contemporary LLMs (e.g. ChatGPT, Bard, etc.) is a plus 
- Excellent problem-solving, creative thinking, general modeling, and data processing skills 
- Strong project management skills, self-starter, ability to adapt and multi-task, and a proven track record of delivering quality and accurate results in a fast-paced and high efficiency agency environment 
- Extremely robust verbal and written English language communication skills

jobs_results.title: Data Analyst Intern
jobs_results.description:
Join Fractal Analytics in Jaipur as a Data Analyst Intern and get a real, mentor-led start to your career in data analytics. Over this 3-month In Office internship you will contribute to actual Technology projects, learn how a professional team plans and executes its work, and build a portfolio you can show to future employers.

Day to day, you will be turning raw data into dashboards and insights. Fractal Analytics believes interns learn best when they are trusted with real responsibility, so you will not be sidelined to filing or fetching coffee — you will be a contributing member of the team. Your mentor will set clear goals each week, walk you through the tools and processes the team uses, and review your output so you steadily improve.

What you will do day to day:
• Write SQL queries to pull, join and aggregate data
• Build interactive dashboards in Power BI / Tableau
• Analyse trends and answer business questions
• Automate recurring reports and metrics
• Clean and validate data quality
• Present insights and recommendations to stakeholders

You will work the way the team actually works — with clear weekly priorities, regular check-ins, and the real tools of the trade. Expect to use SQL, Advanced Excel, Power BI and other industry-standard tools, learn the team's process for planning and reviewing work, and understand how individual tasks roll up into the bigger data analytics goals at Fractal Analytics. Nothing here is busywork; every task is something the team genuinely needs done.

On the skills side, you will get hands-on with SQL, Advanced Excel, Power BI, Tableau and more. Beyond the tools, you will pick up the habits that separate good professionals from beginners — breaking problems down, documenting your work, communicating clearly, meeting deadlines, and improving from feedback. These are the exact skills recruiters look for when they hire freshers.

This internship is a great fit if you are a student or recent graduate who is curious, dependable and eager to learn. You do not need years of experience — a solid grasp of the basics, a willingness to put in the effort, and good communication will take you far. Candidates from B.E./B.Tech, BBA, MBA, B.Com, BCA, MCA, B.A., B.Sc or an equivalent program are all welcome to apply.

What does a great Data Analyst Intern look like here? Someone reliable who turns feedback into improvement and gradually needs less hand-holding. Fractal Analytics notices that kind of growth and rewards it — with more responsibility, a strong recommendation, and a genuine shot at a longer-term offer. Regardless of where you go next, you will walk away with a portfolio, a network and habits that make you far more employable.

Why do this internship? You get genuine project experience, a mentor invested in your growth, a completion certificate and a letter of recommendation — plus a real shot at a PPO if you impress. Being based in Jaipur, you also tap into one of the country's strongest professional ecosystems, which matters a lot early in a career.

Internship details — Role: Data Analyst Intern. Location: Jaipur (In Office). Duration: 3 months. Stipend: ₹12,000/month. Openings: 3. Start: Immediately. This is a paid internship; the stipend is fixed and paid monthly.

This is a verified, fully reviewed listing on MyInternships.in. To apply, simply sign in to your free candidate account and click "Apply Now" — you can submit your resume and details in a couple of minutes. There are no charges and no third-party redirects. Responsibilities: Write SQL queries to pull, join and aggregate data; Build interactive dashboards in Power BI / Tableau; Analyse trends and answer business questions; Automate recurring reports and metrics; Clean and validate data quality; Present insights and recommendations to stakeholders. Requirements: Pursuing or recently completed a relevant degree (B.E./B.Tech, BBA, MBA, B.Com, BCA, MCA, B.A., B.Sc or an equivalent program); Foundational knowledge of SQL, Advanced Excel, Power BI or a strong willingness to learn them; Good written and verbal communication, ownership and analytical thinking; Based in or open to working from Jaipur (In Office); Able to commit to the full internship duration.

Excellent experience using Python (or R) to analyze data from extremely large or complex data sets

Experience working with a visualization tool (preferably, but not restricted to Tableau)
